```json
{
  "winner": "B",
  "reasons": [
    "B has a defined payer and price. Creators pay a platform fee, anchored to published, sourced pricing: Memberful at $49/mo + 4.9% and Patreon at 10% + processing. A's own brief says the product and customer are unresolved ('one-line description to confirm', customer 'varies by idea').",
    "B's demand evidence is two direct r/patreon posts about creators wanting to leave over fees, one stating an intent to switch. A's demand evidence is one vague post from a third-party mirror, and the same thread contains a rebuttal of the premise ('you can just vibe code if you have an idea').",
    "B's competitors have sourced, published pricing and stated scale (Ko-fi 'chosen by 1M creators'), so willingness to pay exists in the category. A's named direct competitors are all free and pre-revenue, and two show dummy or illustrative data. A's only paid comparable, CoFoundersLab, is in an adjacent category.",
    "B cites a sourced precedent of a non-technical founder plus one contractor reaching ~$140K MRR. It also names the condition that made it work (a niche with an owned audience), which gives a 90-day plan a concrete wedge to test. A cites no precedent of a paying customer for friend-sourced prototype building.",
    "B's risks (saturation, switching costs, compliance load) are real but specific and mitigable. The brief proposes Stripe-hosted fields and a one-time fintech attorney consult. A's core risk is that the need itself is disappearing as non-coders use AI tools to build for themselves, which is harder to work around."
  ],
  "weakest_evidence_in_loser": "Idea A's demand evidence is a single post saying 'Looking for someone to make apps with...', taken from a third-party Reddit mirror snapshot rather than the original thread. It is not tied to any willingness to pay, and the same thread contains a direct rebuttal of the premise. A's acquisition-cost estimate ($100-200 per paying customer) is also weak: it comes from a vendor blog that the brief itself says is not independently verified.",
  "confidence_note": "Moderate-to-high confidence. B is clearly better evidenced on payer, price and demand. However, B's own brief flags that the only success case relied on a pre-existing owned audience, and that incumbents dominate the main acquisition channel. Either could keep a solo founder from reaching a paying customer within 90 days."
}
```
